title: A great way to learn about Sevilla!

title: Our tour guide,...

title: Walking tour
text:
Excellent tour with Fredrick. We saw main sites in Seville and were recommended places to eat and site see. Good pace and considerate for the tour party. 
Felt welcomed and he was always clear and knowledgable.
author: Nigel_K

title: Seville amazed us.
text:
Seville is a magnificent city that deserves several days to be fully explored.
Starting in May, the temperatures are already very high; we had about 29 degrees, which makes visits quite tiring when they quickly follow organized excursions by the hotel.
We still had the chance to discover the famous Plaza de España, absolutely breathtaking... a truly incredible place, amazing!
A slight disappointment, however, regarding the boat tour of the monuments from the 1992 World Expo. The excursion, quite expensive, was quick, and the buildings, as well as the Ariane rocket, were visible from very far a
author: Gilles D
